tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Return a browser link that redirects to Stripe Checkout for the selected plan.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_checkout_link" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Create a live Stripe Checkout link for a plan. Returns a URL a human opens to pay; nothing is charged by this call." → after: "Return a browser link that redirects to Stripe Checkout for the selected plan."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
